## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 3-fascicle commentary on the *[Smaller Sukhāvatī](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0082)* is the more substantial of [窺基](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E7%AA%BA%E5%9F%BA) Kuījī's two commentaries on the work (alongside the more compact [T1757](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6f/KR6f0088)). The *tōng zàn* "through-eulogy" format includes verse-eulogies alongside the prose commentary.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (660 – 682) reflects Kuījī's mature scholarly period.

The Taishō text (T1758) is established on the standard apparatus.
